prior.rule:
(declared before looking at the pilot): candidates grouped into families
{lR}, {dm, dm_g}, {ls, ls_g}, {lh}, {lA, n}, {gw}; within a family the member with the largest headroom
(min over the two edges) among those viable at both edges; then the 4 families with the largest such
headroom. Prior = the scanned box (uniform). A candidate with a non-viable edge is not eligible (its box would
need a narrower rescan).

shrink.why: the full scanned box failed viability at 6 of 16 corners (results/viab_joint_full.json): 3 corners with low lR and low dm_00 fill the 12 tracker slots on 45-78% of ticks (two of them also have median speed 0.43-0.45 < 0.5); 2 corners with high lR, high dm_00, low ls_00 keep only 2.0-2.9 bodies on average (minimum 1-2; the one at low lh also has speed 0.48); 1 corner (high lR, low dm_00, low ls_00, high lh) has stalled bodies (median speed 0.31). Median speed < 0.5 at 4 corners, not 2.

scan.design: 3 members x (50 burn-in + 30 ticks); 6 branch states (3 class a, 3 class d 300 nats); R = 4 truths (theta) + m = 4 controls (theta_0) per state, H = 8

cost_model.doc:
(member-ticks, one hidden world = one truth theta; burn-in 50, prefix P = 16):
  starts        n (50 + P)
  L1 truths     n R H1                  (H1 = 16)
  L2 extension  n R2 (H2 - H1)          (level-2 cells to H2 = 64; R2 = R, or 4 as CRITIQUE 5 suggests)
  climatology   n_clim (50 + H2)        (n_clim = 256, EXAM 4.2)
  plug-in diag  n m H1                  (prior-mean plug-in from the true x_P, m = 16; optional)
  B3 training   N_b3 per truth          (true-theta level-1 predictor; 47,160 = the closure study's data)
  prior-mean control training: N_b3 once.
SBI baseline (B2): amortised NPE on summaries: N_sim draws x (50 + T_sim) member-ticks, shared by all
truths; or a per-truth synthetic likelihood (EXAM 6.3: 1,000 draws x 4 members x 100 ticks per world);
then a B1/B3-class predictor trained on posterior draws per truth.
CPU-hours at the measured 0.13-0.16 s per member-tick (this study: results/check_gworld.json, scan.json).

synthetic_likelihood_per_truth_EXAM.note: 1,000 draws x 4 members x 100 ticks per truth (EXAM 6.3), x 16 truths

agent_real_world_ticks.note: T_max = 10,000 real ticks per agent run (EXAM 5), one run per truth

code_review: gworld.tick = actuation/wind.WindWorld.tick_x without the kick, with theta_A, n, gw traced; check_gworld shows bit-identical level 0 at default theta (6 state-ticks). Radius scaling (R+15)*lR-15 matches flowlenia_jax.kernel_fft's use of (R+15).

Plug-in pair: plugin_samples clones the exam's hidden x_P snapshot and rolls out the same dense test program (indexed by absolute time, as HistoryExam's truths) with m = 8 fresh keys under true theta or the box centre; world.params is read at call time (vw/world.py Designer.rollout). plugin_true pooled OES 0.994 +- 0.006 is consistent with 1, as it must be.
Ridge pair: ridge_true trained on 4 x 60 ticks under the truth, ridge_prior on 4 x 60 under the box centre; same features; scored by the same HistoryExam. Ignore-actions variant drops wind features.
Lab smoke: Lab.run validates the whole program before running; usage after rejections is 8 nats, 2 ticks.

wording_corrections: Report: shrunk-box failures 'are corners with low lR and low dm_00 (one also has low ls_00 and high lh)' is wrong. All 4 failing corners have low dm_00 (-0.15); 3 have low lR (0.91) and fail on the slot cap (40-67% of ticks); the 4th has HIGH lR (1.09), low ls_00, high lh and fails on stalled bodies (median speed 0.23) (results/viab_joint.json).

Report: 'the linear patch ridge cannot exploit theta, even with 4x the data' is too strong. The ridge pair separates on 1 of 4 truths (truth 2: +0.26, z 2.3; the truth with the largest plug-in gap, 0.44); the 4x data test was run on truth 3 only (32 overlapping windows from 8 members, so its z values are optimistic). Correct: 'not separated pooled (0.063, z 1.3 item-level, 0.8 truth-clustered)'.

Report: 'the reason is predictor quality, not theta headroom' is a hypothesis. The plug-in pair uses the hidden x_P; it shows headroom given the state, not for a history-only predictor. Not yet shown.
Report: 'z = 5.6' should be read with the truth-clustered z about 3.1 (gap positive on 4 of 4 truths, near zero on the truth nearest the centre).

Report: 'the level-2 cells carry the identification signal' is overstated: level-2 plug-in gaps are larger (0.64, 0.43) but noisy (SE 0.21, 0.12); level 1 at h = 8, 16 gives 0.21, 0.43 at SE 0.03, 0.07.

Report: next step 1 'decides check 2' cannot be decided on one truth: per-truth plug-in gaps run 0.02-0.44. Use >= 4 truths: (4 + 1) x 47,160 = 236k member-ticks = 8.5-10.5 CPU-h of simulation, plus training. '3.4-4.2 CPU-h for two theta plus training' covers simulation only.

Unflagged deviation from EXAM 6.3: hidden dm and ls act on kernel group 0->0 only (dm_00, ls_00), not on all 20 kernels; viability was checked over 100 ticks after burn-in, not 300. Within-family choice ls_00 (0.107 +- 0.019) over ls_01 (0.098 +- 0.027) is within noise (winner's curse); the 4 chosen families are clear of the 5th (alpha, 0.049).

checker.verdict: Numbers correct and reproducible. 'Hidden parameters matter given the true state' holds (4 of 4 truths positive, truth-clustered z about 3). 'Check 2 not met by the ridge' holds; the causal attribution to predictor quality and the 'cannot exploit theta' wording do not follow yet.
